title: Uber removes its branding from Uber Safari 4x4 vehicles in Nairobi National Park due to safety concerns and fierce pushback from local guides and tour operators (Caroline Kimeu/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Caroline Kimeu / Wall Street Journal: Uber removes its branding from Uber Safari 4x4 vehicles in Nairobi National Park due to safety concerns and fierce pushback from local guides and tour operators — Ride-hailing company's new business has ignited a fight with traditional wildlife guides — NAIROBI—Uber's new Kenyan safari business …
contentText:
Caroline Kimeu / Wall Street Journal :

Uber removes its branding from Uber Safari 4x4 vehicles in Nairobi National Park due to safety concerns and fierce pushback from local guides and tour operators   —  Ride-hailing company's new business has ignited a fight with traditional wildlife guides  —  NAIROBI—Uber's new Kenyan safari business …
